name: Spearphishing Attachment
description: Send a malicious attachment to a target user to gain initial access.
steps:
1. Craft a malicious document with embedded macro
2. Send via email to target mailbox
3. Confirm delivery and document open
expectedDetection: Alert on suspicious child process spawned from Office application
logSource: Windows Security Event Log;Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

name: PowerShell Execution
description: Execute encoded PowerShell command to download and run a payload.
steps:
1. Open elevated PowerShell prompt
2. Run: powershell -enc <base64payload>
3. Confirm reverse shell established
expectedDetection: Alert on PowerShell with encoded command or download cradle
logSource: Sysmon Event ID 1;PowerShell Script Block Logging
notes: Test both constrained and unconstrained language mode
